# Essential Watches

> > Essential Watches is a Beverly Hills-based luxury watch dealer specializing in pre-owned Rolex, Patek Philippe, A. Lange & Söhne, and Breguet timepieces.

The site offers authenticated pre-owned luxury watches with detailed listings for iconic models like the Rolex Daytona, Patek Philippe Gondolo, and A. Lange & Söhne complications. Educational content covers watch history, movements, and collecting, with a focus on high-end mechanical timepieces and chronographs.

## Key Topics

- Rolex Daytona
- Patek Philippe
- A. Lange & Söhne
- Breguet
- Pre-owned luxury watches
- Automatic movements
- Chronograph complications
- White gold watches
- Yellow gold watches
- Meteorite dials
- Rolex Air King
- Beverly Hills
- Mechanical watches
- Leather straps
- Watch collecting

- [16628 used black mop Rolex Yacht-Master I Yellow Gold from 1990s](https://www.essential-watches.com/watch/Pre-Owned-Rolex-16628-Yacht-Master-40mm-in-Yellow-Gold-on-Bracelet-with-Black-MOP-Dial/16668): Pre-owned Rolex Yacht-Master 16628 yellow gold with black MOP dial
